title: Agentypical Certified — plain rules
meaning: The service has been reviewed against the Agentypical Standard and agents can discover, evaluate, enrol, configure, pay or arrange sponsorship, operate, and receive evidence — with human involvement only where genuinely required.
rules: Certified is earned by review against the Agentypical Standard — never self-asserted on this site.
Empty categories and zero Certified cards are honest and preferred over fake badges.
Inventing or displaying a Certified badge without a reviewed Certified card is forbidden.
Public directory seeds may use status known or evaluating only until certification is live and earned.
Submissions via list-my-service go to a review queue and are not auto-published as known, evaluating, or Certified.
Certification application and status-query APIs are not ready (actions_not_ready includes certify).
